title: Options and OS personalisation
summary: Feedback on options and OS personalisation spans liked customisation features, some dissatisfaction with unavailable or unimpressive options, and many comments that only describe complexity or difficulty locating functions without a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the availability of options and the personalisation features.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on not getting desired options and finding the service options unimpressive.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe many options, detailed OS displays, and functions that are hard to locate or learn, but the sentiment is unclear from the fragments alone.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence about overall customer feeling on this topic.
The examples mix several subjects, including personalisation features, service options, touchscreen menus, OS9 displays, and physical switch location.
Some fragments are too brief to tell whether comments about complexity or learning effort are complaints or neutral observations.
